phonemize_text: phonemize text using g2p, g2pc, or ipa backends with optional language and punctuation settings
tokenize_text: tokenize text using a sentencepiece model or return raw text if no model is configured
tts_predict: predict speech waveform from text using TTSHubInterface with optional speaker selection and verbose logging
vocoder_predict: predict audio waveform from discrete units using VocoderHubInterface with optional speaker and duration prediction
get_tts_model_input: get model input dictionary from text with phonemization, tokenization, and speaker encoding for TTS inference
